description:
Job Description

Position: Continuous Improvement Specialist

Direct Supervisor: Lean & 6-Sigma Manager

Backup:

Related KPI:

• Improve project completion rate.

• Project revenue achievement rate

• Rationalization proposal quantity completion rate

Summary/Objective

The primary role of the Continuous improvement Specialist is assisting the lean & 6-Sigma Manager to lean and advance the department planning and the overall operation planning. Meantime, grasping the company business conditions in times and distinguishing the improving program from quality, effectiveness, inventory, and material consumption etc. Updating well organized work plans and project management documents on time. Ensure the project meets the goal and achieves expected benefits. Improving processes by lean methods to improve efficiency, promote self-process completion and improve good product condition and compliance. Furthermore, grasping the progress of each project in time, promote the development of project and regularly organize project collection and publication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Responsible for the promotion of various improvement projects of the company.

• Responsible for improving the project's revenue goal.

• Responsible for production process improvement and optimization.

Work Environment

This job operates between manufacturing and office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines as well as interfacing with the operation of machinery on the floor.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

This is a full-time position. The days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

• Must be 18 years or older.

Travel

Occasional travel is expected for this position.

Required Education and Experience

• Min. bachelor’s degree, Statistics, Econometrics and similar.

• Proficient in strong planning, organization, and coordination skills.

• Proficient in Ability to check.

• Proficient in Master the use of data analysis and statistical methods

• Proficient in office software.

Position Key Result Index

• Project completion rate.

• Project revenue achievement rate.

Preferred Education and Experience

With one or more years of plastic processing and design experience, an undergraduate degree and/or a combination of education and experience.

Bilingual in English and Chinese

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The Receptionist will be the face and voice of the organization and greet, assist, and provide direction and information to clients, visitors, and other guests.

• Welcome and check in clients, visitors, and guests, determine the purpose of the visit, and connect visitors with host.

Direct SupervisorLead SupervisorDirect SubordinatesCoordinator/Utility/Allocation Forklift

II. Job Summary：The Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the activities of production workers on the manufacturing floor. They will ensure that production processes are carried out efficiently, safely, and according to established quality standards. The Production Supervisor will supervise production staff, assign tasks, monitor progress, and implement corrective actions as needed to meet production targets. Additionally, they will be responsible for maintaining a clean and organized work environment, enforcing safety regulations, and fostering a positive work culture. The Production Supervisor will work closely with other departments such as maintenance, quality control, and logistics to coordinate activities and resolve issues. They will also participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimize production processes and enhance overall operational efficiency.

III. Job Functions and Duties

NO.Representative Duties

1Supervise and coordinate the activities of production workers on the shop floor.

2Ensure that production processes are carried out efficiently and according to established standards.

3Assign tasks to production workers and ensure that they are completed on time.

4Monitor production schedules and adjust as needed to meet production targets.

5Train new production workers and provide ongoing guidance and support to existing staff.

6Enforce safety regulations and ensure that all workers adhere to safety protocols.

7Maintain a clean and organized work environment to promote efficiency and safety.

8Conduct regular inspections of equipment and machinery to ensure proper functioning.

9Troubleshoot production issues and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.

10Communicate with other departments such as maintenance, quality control, and logistics to coordinate activities and resolve issues.

11Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with procurement to ensure adequate supply of materials.

12Implement quality control measures to maintain product quality and consistency.

13Analyze production data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement.

14Implement productivity improvement initiatives to optimize production processes.

15Address employee concerns and resolve conflicts as they arise.

16Conduct performance evaluations of production workers and provide feedback for improvement.

17Participate in meetings with management to provide updates on production activities and performance.

18Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for production processes.

19Collaborate with engineering teams to implement process improvements and new technologies.

20Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

21Manage production documentation and record-keeping.

title: Automation Technician
description:
Summary/Objective:

The Automation Technician is responsible for maintaining and managing automation equipment, including spare parts inventory, system backups, and operational efficiency. This role ensures equipment reliability through regular inspections, modifications, and upgrades while maintaining a clean and organized work environment. Additionally, the technician provides training on equipment operations and best practices.

Essential Functions:

• Ensure the smooth operation of automation equipment through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting.

• Manage and maintain an accurate inventory of spare parts related to automation equipment.

• Regularly back up and update automation programs to ensure system reliability and efficiency.

• Develop and implement equipment modification and upgrade plans, as well as inspection schedules.

• Perform routine hardware inspections, including dust protection, component tightening, and replacement of worn parts.

• Maintain a clean and organized work environment in compliance with 5S standards.

• Provide training and guidance on equipment operation and best practices to relevant personnel.

Competencies:

• Robotics Programming and Mechatronics

• Problem Solving and Analysis

• Project Management

• Communication Proficiency

• Ethical Conduct

• Time Management

Supervisory Responsibility:

This position has no supervisor responsibility.

Work Environment:

• This position is primarily on the facility floor with light desk work. Regularly working with automation equipment and mechanical tools.

• Must be 18 years or older.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:
this is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel:

Sometimes travel to our supplier may happen.

Required Education and Experience:

• Basic mechanical aptitude and manufacturing plant experience.

• Minimum of one year of general robotics maintenance and programming experience.

Preferred Education and Experience:

• Five or more years of maintenance experience.

• Understanding of injection molding machine systems, including electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.

• Advanced robotics experience, including programming.

Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Component Design and Development Engineer
description:
Job Description

Position:  Component Engineer

Classification: Exempt

Direct Supervisor:  Design and Development Supervisor

Backup: Design and Development Manager

Related KPI:

Summary/Objectives:

The Design & Development Component Engineer ensures the timely and accurate development, improvement, and validation of automotive accessories and components. This position plays a critical role in controlling product design and development processes while supporting the applicable sales area. The engineer will work closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and quality assurance to optimize product performance and compliance with industry standards.

Essential Functions:

• Lead the development of accessories, from feasibility evaluation to final validation.

• Conduct product quotations, technical planning, and development in coordination with sales and engineering teams.

• Develop components based on customer drawings and specifications, ensuring accuracy in design and application.

• Oversee supplier selection, accessory code applications, and standard conversions for new components.

• Validate and approve first-batch production samples, ensuring alignment with drawings and specifications.

• Assist procurement and quality assurance in supplier audits and QTS recognition.

• Track accessory development progress, maintain accessory code catalogs, and manage sample production.

• Prepare technical documents, inspection reports, and testing results for first article recognition.

• Verify and optimize technical processes for accessory installation tools.

• Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for accessory development and production.

• Support cross-functional teams in continuous improvement initiatives, including:

• Kaizen implementation

• Cross-training efforts

• Problem-solving and defect reduction

• Participate in failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to mitigate design risks.

• Ensure compliance with relevant automotive industry standards, including IATF 16949.

• Other duties as assigned.

Competencies:

• Technical Skills:

• Strong knowledge of CAD software (AutoCAD, UG NX, CATIA, Pro/E).

• Experience with component design, mold structures, and processing technologies.

• Understanding of accessory bonding processes and vehicle glazing system components.

• Familiarity with polymer materials, small injection molding, and stamping die development.

• Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills:

• Ability to analyze engineering data and solve practical design and manufacturing challenges.

• Strong mathematical skills, including proficiency in unit conversions and cost analysis.

• Project & Supplier Management:

• Experience in project management, APQP processes, and supplier development.

• Knowledge of raw materials, processing costs, and accessory manufacturing capabilities.

• Industry Standards & Compliance:

• TS16949, Six Sigma, and process improvement methodologies.

• Understanding of five automotive reference manuals.

• Communication & Collaboration:

• Fluency in English (reading, writing, and speaking); Mandarin proficiency is a plus.

• Strong ability to interact effectively with team members, leadership, engineers, and customers.

• Experience in preparing technical reports and conducting training sessions.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to: stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The position involves sitting, walking, and lifting 15 pounds for long periods throughout the day.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, see Production Manager for hours. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required.

Travel:

Little travel is expected for this position.

Required Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering (or related field).

• Experience with Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software (UG NX and/or CATIA V5).

• Knowledge of GD&T principles.

• 1 to 3 years of experience in manufacturing, engineering, or component development.

Preferred Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Bilingual in English and Chinese is plus

Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Fire Alarm and Life Safety Engineer
description:
I. Job ProfileJob TitleFire Alarm and Life Safety EngineerDepartmentSystem Engineering Department

Direct SupervisorUtility Maintenance ManagerDirect SubordinatesNone

II. Job Summary:
1. Responsible for the reliability, compliance, maintenance, and lifecycle management of plant fire alarm and life safety systems.
2. Plans inspections, testing, preventive maintenance, repairs, system improvements, and emergency restoration activities.
3. Coordinates contractors, EHS, Facility, Production, Security, monitoring companies, and authorities having jurisdiction as required.

III. Job Functions and Duties

NO.Representative Duties

1Manage fire alarm and life safety systems, including control panels, initiating devices, notification appliances, sprinkler supervisory and waterflow signals, fire pump signals, emergency lighting, exit signs, fire doors, fire/smoke dampers, and special suppression interfaces.

2Maintain a complete equipment register, point list, panel/network inventory, zone map, riser interface list, and current system status for all covered facilities.

3Develop and maintain daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, and multi-year inspection, testing, and preventive maintenance plans.

4Review and respond to fire alarm, supervisory, trouble, disabled, bypassed, and communication conditions; coordinate timely repair and restoration.

5Lead or support functional testing of alarm initiation, notification, central-station transmission, fire pump signals, air-handling shutdown, door release, elevator recall, smoke control, gas shutoff, and other approved cause-and-effect functions.

6Administer fire protection impairment procedures, including system isolation, notifications, fire watch, temporary protection, restoration, and closure documentation.

7Review fire alarm and life safety drawings, point lists, sequence of operations, battery calculations, voltage-drop calculations, network diagrams, product submittals, and as-built documents.

8Plan and coordinate new installations, modifications, replacements, permitting support, commissioning, acceptance testing, and turnover documentation.

9Manage contractors, service agreements, quotations, purchase requests, schedules, site access, safety requirements, and vendor performance.

10Maintain compliance with applicable fire alarm, fire protection, electrical, building, and life safety requirements, including company standards and adopted codes.

11Maintain inspection reports, test records, annual tags, deficiency logs, repair records, permits, warranties, software backups, and system programming documentation.

12Investigate nuisance alarms, repeat trouble conditions, device failures, communication issues, and other recurring problems; complete root-cause analysis and corrective action.

13Develop critical spare-parts plans and lifecycle replacement strategies for panels, power supplies, batteries, modules, detectors, notification devices, and communication equipment.

14Provide emergency response and after-hours support for fire alarm and life safety system failures, impairments, and restoration activities.

15Provide technical training and operating guidance to Facility, Utility, Security, EHS, and other affected personnel.

16Nothing in the Position Description restricts management's right to assign or re-assign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

IV. Qualification

Job RequirementsLanguageEnglish is required. Mandarin is preferred but not required. Ability to read, understand, and interpret safety rules, codes, drawings, specifications, operating instructions, maintenance manuals, test reports, and written procedures. Ability to communicate effectively with technicians, engineers, leadership, contractors, inspectors, and emergency-response personnel.

ExperienceThree or more years of experience with fire alarm, life safety, fire protection, electrical controls, or related building systems in an industrial, manufacturing, commercial, or institutional environment. Experience with addressable fire alarm systems, central-station monitoring, sprinkler monitoring, and system commissioning is preferred.

EducationBachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, and relevant experience.

Physical ConditionThe employee is regularly required to stand, walk, climb stairs, use ladders or lifts, bend, reach, and work in equipment rooms, production areas, and rooftop locations. The position may require lifting to 50 pounds and working in hot, cold, noisy, dusty, or outdoor conditions. Visual acuity, color recognition, depth perception, and the ability to read device labels, wiring, drawings, and test instruments are required. Required personal protective equipment may include safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, fall protection, and electrical PPE as applicable.

Other RequirementsAbility to troubleshoot electrical and low-voltage circuits, analyze practical problems, manage multiple priorities, and work independently. Must be able to support scheduled shutdowns, emergency response, occasional overtime, and after-hours work. Knowledge of permit, impairment, LOTO, electrical safety, and contractor-control procedures is required. NICET Fire Alarm Systems certification or equivalent manufacturer training is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities utilized on the jobProfessional Knowledge, SkillsWorking knowledge of fire alarm and life safety requirements, including NFPA 72, NFPA 25, NFPA 13, NFPA 20, NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, NFPA 80, NFPA 101, applicable building/fire codes, and local requirements.

Knowledge of addressable fire alarm panels, initiating devices, notification appliances, releasing systems, power supplies, batteries, networked panels, and central-station communication.

Knowledge of sprinkler waterflow, valve tamper, fire pump, dry-system, deluge, clean-agent, CO₂, and other life safety system interfaces.

Ability to read and develop fire alarm drawings, riser diagrams, point lists, cause-and-effect matrices, sequence-of-operation documents, and as-built records.

Ability to perform or oversee inspections, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and verification using appropriate meters, software, and fire alarm test equipment.

Strong root-cause analysis skills for nuisance alarms, recurring trouble conditions, device failures, communication faults, and system impairments.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CMMS/document-control systems, PDF review tools, and AutoCAD or similar drawing software.

Project planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, contractor management, and construction coordination skills.

Clear technical writing, report preparation, recordkeeping, and communication skills.

Strong organization, judgment, teamwork, and emergency-response coordination skills.

Training RequiredFire alarm system manufacturer training and applicable NFPA 72 inspection, testing, programming, or maintenance training.

LOTO, electrical safety / arc-flash awareness, lift and fall-protection training, and other site-required safety training.

Plex/EPAC or applicable CMMS training, document-control procedures, impairment/fire-watch procedures, and company emergency-response training.

V. Work Environment:
Work is performed in offices, manufacturing areas, equipment rooms, electrical rooms, rooftops, warehouses, and outdoor locations. The employee may be exposed to heat, cold, noise, dust, moving equipment, energized systems, ladders, lifts, and emergency conditions. Required PPE and all site safety procedures must be followed.

VI. Key Performance Indicators:
1. On-time completion rate for required inspections, testing, and preventive maintenance.
2. Number of open fire alarm trouble, supervisory, disabled, and bypassed conditions.
3. Average closure time for deficiencies and failed test items.
4. Frequency of nuisance alarms, repeat alarms, and recurring system faults.
5. Duration and documentation compliance of system impairments.
6. Accuracy and completeness of drawings, point lists, reports, and maintenance records.
7. Project completion performance for scope, schedule, budget, commissioning, and turnover.
8. Individual work injuries and safety incidents (OSHA recordable).

title: General Utility
description:
Fuyao is the largest automotive glass manufacturer in China and the second largest in the world. Fuyao is an established automotive glass manufacturing in the United States in Dayton, OH, and Mt. Zion, IL, investing in excess of $1 Billion in capital. Its main customers include GM, Honda, BMW, Volvo, Volkswagen, FCA, Toyota, Hyundai, and Kia, to name a few.

Fuyao Glass offers an excellent benefits package, including Health, Medical, Dental, Short Disability, as well as a 401(k) plan.

Position Summary:

The GU employee’s main tasks in closing are to inspect glass containers that are delivered to the closing area prior to closing. A basic visual inspection looking for stagger, breakage, bad cuts, etc. to ensure we deliver a quality product through the closing process ready to ship to our customers. This includes the use of manual, automatic tooling to prep, wrap, and band the glass in the containers. Trucking is also part of this process. At times there will be other tasks or special projects that may be required for the GU to assist in completing.

Primary Duties:

title: Project Management Engineer
Advance Quality Engineer
Project Engineer
description:
About the Role:

The Project Engineer - Utility is responsible for planning, engineering, executing, and closing utility and infrastructure projects in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The position leads projects from problem definition and technical scope development through procurement, construction, commissioning, and final turnover. The role supports safe, reliable, code-compliant, and energy-efficient operation of the plant's utility systems while maintaining clear ownership of project cost, schedule, quality, risk, and documentation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Project definition and planning. Evaluate operational needs, recurring failures, capacity constraints, compliance gaps, and energy-saving opportunities; develop project charters, scopes of work, budgetary estimates, schedules, risk registers, and implementation plans.

• Engineering and technical design. Prepare or review calculations, equipment selections, layouts, one-line diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams, control narratives, technical specifications, bid packages, and construction drawings.

• Utility systems engineering. Support projects involving medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, compressed air, chilled and cooling water, process water and RO systems, wastewater and water-treatment systems, HVAC and dehumidification, natural gas, building controls, and related plant infrastructure.

• Capacity and reliability analysis. Analyze current and future utility demand, redundancy, equipment condition, failure history, and production impact; recommend technically and financially justified solutions.

• Cross-functional coordination. Coordinate requirements and project impacts with Production, Maintenance, Utility Operations, Facility, EHS, Quality, IT/Controls, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders. Communicate constraints, shutdown needs, risks, and decisions in a timely manner.

• Procurement and vendor management. Develop RFQ packages, conduct site walks, answer bidder questions, complete technical bid evaluations, support vendor selection, and verify that purchased equipment and services meet project requirements.

• Cost and change control. Track commitments, forecasts, invoices, contingency, and cost-to-complete; review contractor quotations and change orders; promptly escalate deviations from approved scope, budget, or schedule.

• Construction and contractor coordination. Coordinate field activities, access, permits, material staging, production interfaces, outages, and daily work plans. Inspect installation progress and workmanship and document deficiencies, action items, and recovery plans.

• Safety and compliance. Integrate applicable OSHA, NFPA, NEC, environmental, insurance, state, and local code requirements into project planning and execution. Coordinate LOTO, energized-work restrictions, hot work, lift plans, confined-space requirements, and other site safety controls with EHS and authorized personnel.

• Shutdown and cutover planning. Develop detailed method-of-procedure plans, outage schedules, temporary utility arrangements, contingency plans, and restoration steps to minimize production and business interruption.

• Quality assurance and commissioning. Verify submittals and installation quality; coordinate inspections, testing, FAT/SAT activities, startup, functional performance testing, punch-list closure, training, and formal acceptance.

• Project turnover and records. Deliver complete closeout packages, including approved drawings, as-built records, equipment data, O&M manuals, test reports, warranties, spare-parts recommendations, PM requirements, and asset information for the CMMS or equipment register.

• Operational and emergency support. Provide engineering troubleshooting and root-cause support for significant utility failures or project-related issues. Participate in planned shutdowns and occasional after-hours response when business needs require.

• Energy and continuous improvement. Identify and implement projects that reduce utility consumption, peak demand, operating cost, emissions, water use, and unplanned downtime; establish baselines and verify results using appropriate KPIs.

• Reporting and governance. Maintain accurate project schedules, meeting minutes, issue logs, risk registers, action lists, forecasts, status reports, and decision records. Follow applicable capital-approval and document-control processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

• Proven experience in project engineering or a similar role within the engineering or construction industry.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD and the ability to produce and interpret detailed shop drawings.

• Strong understanding of project management principles and experience using Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling software.

• Demonstrated ability to perform cost estimation and manage change orders effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.

• Experience with advanced engineering design software beyond AutoCAD.

• Familiarity with industry-specific codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Previous experience working on large-scale or complex engineering projects.

• Strong leadership skills with experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and review detailed engineering designs and shop drawings using AutoCAD to ensure accuracy and compliance with project specifications.

• Prepare and manage cost estimations, budgets, and change orders to maintain financial control throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate project activities by liaising with internal teams, contractors, and clients to ensure seamless communication and timely delivery of milestones.

• Utilize Microsoft Project to create, update, and monitor project schedules, identifying potential risks and implementing mitigation strategies.

• Support the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and presentations to communicate project status and engineering decisions to stakeholders.

Skills:

The required skills such as AutoCAD and shop drawing expertise are essential for creating precise engineering designs and ensuring technical accuracy on a daily basis. Project engineering and design skills enable the candidate to develop innovative solutions and adapt designs to meet evolving project needs. Cost estimation and change order management are critical for maintaining budgetary control and responding to project scope adjustments efficiently. Project coordination and the use of Microsoft Project facilitate effective scheduling, resource allocation, and communication among stakeholders, ensuring projects progress smoothly. Preferred skills like advanced design software proficiency and leadership capabilities further enhance the ability to manage complex projects and lead teams toward successful outcomes.

description:

Reporting to Fuyao Automotive North America, Inc., this position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs to ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Local regulations. This role works closely with the management team to foster a safety-first culture and promote collaboration across departments to enhance workplace safety and efficiency.

title: Process Engineer
description:
About the Role:

As a Process Engineer within the Automotive Glass Manufacturing Industry, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and enhancing manufacturing processes to ensure high-quality product delivery and operational efficiency. Your primary focus will be on analyzing current processes, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing innovative solutions that reduce waste and increase productivity. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, quality assurance, and supply chain to align process improvements with business objectives. Utilizing advanced process simulation and control techniques, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives that support sustainable manufacturing practices. Ultimately, your expertise will contribute to delivering superior consumer products while maintaining cost-effectiveness and compliance with industry standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in process engineering within a manufacturing or consumer support environment.

• Strong knowledge of process simulation tools and methodologies.

• Proficiency in process control techniques and manufacturing operations.

• Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

• Certification in Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies.

• Experience working in consumer goods manufacturing or support services.

• Familiarity with advanced process automation and control systems.

• Demonstrated success in scrap reduction and waste management projects.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and optimize manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and product quality.

• Conduct process simulations and modeling to predict and enhance process performance.

• Implement process control strategies to maintain consistent production standards and reduce variability.

• Analyze production data using statistical tools such as Minitab to identify trends and root causes of scrap or defects.

• Collaborate with manufacturing operations teams to troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective actions.

• Lead initiatives aimed at scrap reduction and waste minimization to support sustainability goals.

• Document process changes and maintain detailed records to ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards.

• Train and support production staff on new processes and best practices to ensure smooth implementation.

Skills:

The required skills such as Chemical Engineering and Process Engineering form the foundation for designing and optimizing manufacturing workflows. Process Simulation and Process Control skills are applied daily to model processes and maintain consistent production quality. Manufacturing Operations knowledge enables effective collaboration with production teams to implement improvements and troubleshoot issues. Scrap Reduction expertise is critical for identifying inefficiencies and driving cost-saving initiatives. Proficiency in Minitab supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing production data to uncover trends and root causes, ensuring continuous process enhancement.

title: EHS Manager
description:
I. Job ProfileJob TitleEHS ManagerDepartmentEHS

Direct SupervisorDirectorDirect SubordinatesAssigned Associates

II. Job Summary：
The EH&S Manager is responsible for overseeing diverse tasks related to environmental, health and safety needs.  Provide a safe and healthy working environment for all employees.     Implement improvement systems in order to eliminate work-related injuries and ensuring all employees are educated in safe work conditions, practices, and safety requirements.     Manage and monitor a solid and effective safety program, encompassing environmental, safety and health policies and procedures. This position is responsible for the ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification process and shall maintain the relevant management systems.      Responsible for the safe operation and protection of all facility assets. The EH&S Manager is responsible for ensuring the safety of all persons on site, including visitors.

III. Job Functions and Duties

NO.Representative Duties

1Safety in the Work Environment :
1.1  Evaluate work environment to ensure safe practices are established to prevent injuries, accidents, and eliminate work hazards.
1.2  Design and implement safety program to include PPE, hearing protection and noise mapping,  heat stress, LOTO, confined space, hot permit program, electrical safety and fork truck safety, as part of the initial implementation plan.
1.3 Provide safety direction and/or guidance to on-site contractors to ensure compliance with FGA safety rules, policies, and procedures.

2Accident/Injury Investigation:
2.1  Conduct accident investigations immediately upon notice of accident and/or injury; complete within 24 hours at the latest.
2.2   Document interviews with employees and witnesses to the accident/injury.
2.3  Identify root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
2.4  Communicate details of accident and/or injury to Human Resources Director and President.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2.5  Complete and submit, if necessary, worker's compensation report, OSHA log, and other regulatory agencies, including environmental reporting.
2.6  Update and maintain injury and accident statistics to evaluate performance level of program.

3Establish a Culture of Safety:
3.1  Instill a culture of safety throughout the organization.
3.2  Conduct contractor safety training to ensure contractors comply with FGA safety rules, procedures, policies,  and perform work in a safe manner.
3.3  Provide integrated solutions to potential safety hazards.
3.4   Act as a EHS resource to plant management.
3.5  Provide technical support and assist in resolving safety issues to aid production and maintenance goals.

4Industrial Hygiene Program:
4.1  Establish areas of industrial hygiene sampling and monitoring.
4.2   Establish an annual schedule to conduct industrial sampling, including noise sampling.
4.3  Complete and monitor sampling schedule to ensure a safe working environment.
4.4  Immediately implement corrective actions where samplings are out of range.

5Safety Training:
5.1  Design and implement safety training for New Hire Orientation.
5.2  Ensure employee understanding of EHS policies and procedures.
5.3  Test and re-test for understanding and compliance.
5.4  Monitor training courses for attendance and compliance for each employee.

6Project Management:
6.1  Manages, evaluates, and implements appropriate projects that reduce costs, reduces accidents and injuries, and contributes to improved performance of the safety program.

7Lead the EH&S team in achievement of relevant ISO certifications

8Lead investigation of accidents, incidents, and near misses to identify causes and to determine how such accidents might be prevented in the future.  Compiles and submits required OSHA accident reports.

9Assist management in development and reporting of EHS performance metrics to facilitate continuous, ongoing improvement of the EHS efforts and results.

10Follows instructions and performs other duties as may be assigned by supervisor.

11Assists other employees in accomplishment of Fuyao Glass America company goals.

12Participates in and completes company-required training programs.

13Participates in Environmental, Health and Safety initiatives as set forth by the company.

14Essential functions require presence in the workplace on a regular basis and an ability to work extra hours if needed.  If applicable, ability to work overtime may be needed to ensure required shift staffing capacity to meet daily production objectives.

15Lead EH&S team members in the execution of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification efforts. Ensure conformance to polies and procedures developed to ensure the conformance to management system requirements as established in the ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. title: In Process Quality Control
description:
About Fuyao
Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North American market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW, and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers.

Our Parent Company
Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia, and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of the Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of the Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few.

Position: IPQC (In Process Quality Control)

Classification: Non-Exempt

Direct Supervisor: In Process Quality Engineer

Backup: IPQC LEAD/GP12

Related KPI:

• Customer Complaint

• Liaison Feedback Times

• Internal Batch Issues

Summary/Objective

Ensure that the parts being produced meet quality specifications. Help monitor part quality on the Production floor.

Essential Functions

• Perform the First Piece Approval Process with Team Leads and Technicians to ensure the parts conform to standards.

• Monitor the quality of the parts on the line and ensure that the parts meet standards by performing sample audits on the first and last pieces.

• Check the primer path and primer quality on all the lines.

• Perform Daily Process Audits online to make sure that processes are being followed.

• Provide support in training GP12 in job duties and work instructions.

• Dock Audit is responsible for assigned programs.

• Help with containments and proper disposition of the non-conforming material found during Containment.

• Review and sign off on the production scrap produced by the shift.

• Alert all Departments of issues found on the Production Floor and Shipping Dock. Send out daily reports to document and escalate any findings.

• Other duties as assigned by IPQE and IPQC LEAD

Competencies

• Must be familiar with ISO/TS 16949

• Problem Solving/Analysis.

• Communication Proficiency.

• Ethical Conduct.

• Time Management

Supervisory Responsibility

Support IPQE and IPQC LEAD to monitor GP12.

Work Environment

• The job routinely operates on the Production Floor but may require the employee to go to the Shipping Dock/Area. IPQC Leads need to work on the computer to make daily reports.

• Must be 18 years or older

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. This position requires the ability to lift glass over 20 lbs and remain active for most of the day. During this job the employee may have to kneel or squat. The employee must be able to distinguish between different colors and shapes of glass.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
This is a full-time position. Days of work are Monday through Friday. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel

Travel is not expected for this position.

Required Education and Experience

• Two years’ Automotive Quality.

Preferred Education and Experience

• A High School Diploma and 3 years of automotive Quality.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
